errors.title: Glue job command failed
causes: script raised an uncaught exception - look earlier in the log
missing job parameters or wrong arguments

errors.title: IAM permission denied
causes: job IAM role lacks the required action on the resource
missing Glue/S3/catalog permissions on the execution role

errors.title: DPU capacity limit
causes: account DPU quota reached - request increase or lower concurrency

errors.title: Data Catalog client failure
patterns: Error creating the Glue Data Catalog client
causes: connector jar incompatible with the Glue version

errors.title: Unsupported or deprecated Glue version
causes: glue_version set to a version AWS retired
job definition not updated after runtime upgrade

errors.title: Subnet out of IP addresses
patterns: The specified subnet does not have enough free addresses
causes: Glue connection uses ENIs; the subnet ran out of IPs
use a larger subnet or reduce job concurrency

errors.title: Bookmark / state handling issue
causes: bookmark data incompatible across source schema changes
reset the job bookmark for a clean run

errors.title: DynamicFrame schema mismatch
causes: source data mixes types in one column
